Ronna Sue Cohen Raised Its Pembina Pipeline (PBA) Stake by $1.02 Million; Market Valuation Declined; Teva Pharmaceuticals Inds LTD (TEVA) Stock Value Declined While Ion Asset Management LTD Has Cut Holding
May 20, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Bart Baum decreased its stake in Teva Pharmaceuticals Inds Ltd (TEVA) by 38.09% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ion Asset Management Ltd sold 173,450 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.04% with the market. The hedge fund run by Bart Baum held 281,900 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.34M, down from 455,350 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ion Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Teva Pharmaceuticals Inds Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $21.62 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.52% or $0.11 during the last trading session, reaching $21.23. About 11.15 million shares traded. Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited (NYSE:TEVA) has declined 49.50% since May 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 61.05% the S&P500.
Ronna Sue Cohen increased its stake in Pembina Pipeline Corp (PBA) by 36.95% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ronna Sue Cohen bought 28,385 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.97% with the market. The institutional investor held 105,204 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.81M, up from 76,819 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ronna Sue Cohen who had been investing in Pembina Pipeline Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $17.24 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.92% or $0.32 during the last trading session, reaching $34.42. About 629,445 shares traded or 0.95% up from the average. Pembina Pipeline Corporation (NYSE:PBA) has declined 3.38% since May 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.93% the S&P500.

Analysts await Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited (NYSE:TEVA) to report earnings on August, 2. They expect $0.59 earnings per share, down 40.40% or $0.40 from last year’s $0.99 per share. TEVA’s profit will be $600.76 million for 9.00 P/E if the $0.59 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.91 actual earnings per share reported by Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -35.16% negative EPS growth.
